senses.gloss:
doṣa (LP), doing anything wrongly.
 (IE 7-1-2), ‘three’.
 (EI 9), black or red spots on the tongue supposed to be a foreboding of death.
 Cf. daṇḍa-doṣa; fines; see also pradhān-āpradhāna-doṣa-samanvita used as an epithet of the gift village (Ep. Ind., Vol. III, p. 274). Here doṣa apparently means daṇḍa-doṣa.
